title: Solid Waste and Hazardous Waste Management

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding the origin, nature, characteristics, and flow of solid waste and hazardous waste in the economy
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the context, principles, and management of solid waste and hazardous waste.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Identifying and analyzing the functions within the solid waste management system
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Recognize and analyze the roles of stakeholders, economic, social, environmental, and institutional aspects in comprehensive and sustainable solid waste management.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing community-based solid waste management models
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze the roles of participants, influencing factors, organizational structure, and operational principles of community-based solid waste management models.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Applying knowledge to analyze practical solid waste management models
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply knowledge to analyze practical solid waste management models and hazardous waste management models.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Active learning through discussions and problem-solving exercises
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Actively participate in group work by seeking, collecting information, building content, and presenting research results through presentations.
